cohort: 633 pregnant women hospitalized between April 2020 and February 2021 (304 with SARS-CoV-2, 329 healthy controls)
finding: Neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 infected mothers had worse Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes of life and lower ABG pH scores.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery for SARS-CoV-2 infected mothers, while emergency cesarean sections were performed at an earlier gestational age compared to vaginal delivery and elective cesarean section.
